// Clearance corpus for the path-field taint scan (TestPathTaintContainedOK).
// pathfence.Contain clears a Consumed field — directly or inside a helper — and
// a field that is only shown is clean. phase.Task.Files is declared
// NotConsumed: Contain does not clear it, so opening it, even through the seam,
// trips at the opener's line.
package containedok

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/changes"
	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/pathfence"
	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/phase"
)

// A Consumed field through Contain and the seam.
func readConsumed(root string, rec changes.TaskRecord) error {
	for _, f := range rec.Files {
		c, err := pathfence.Contain(root, "changes.json", f)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := pathfence.ReadFile(c); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(c.String()), 0o755); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Contain inside a helper clears per call site.
func containIn(root, p string) (pathfence.Contained, error) {
	return pathfence.Contain(root, "changes.json", p)
}

func readViaHelper(root string, rec *changes.TaskRecord) {
	if c, err := containIn(root, rec.Files[0]); err == nil {
		_, _ = pathfence.Stat(c)
	}
}

// Printed, or carried in an error: a path is meant to be shown.
func printOnly(rec changes.TaskRecord, t phase.Task) error {
	fmt.Println(rec.Files)
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, t.Files)
	return fmt.Errorf("task touches %s", filepath.Join(t.Files...))
}

// NotConsumed through Contain and the seam.
func readNotConsumed(root string, t phase.Task) {
	for _, f := range t.Files {
		c, err := pathfence.Contain(root, "plan.toml", f)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		_, _ = pathfence.ReadFile(c) // WANT pathtaint
	}
}

// ...and through a helper: the finding is the opener's line.
func openContained(c pathfence.Contained) {
	_, _ = pathfence.ReadFile(c) // WANT pathtaint
}

func readNotConsumedViaHelper(root string, t *phase.Task) {
	if c, err := containIn(root, t.Files[0]); err == nil {
		openContained(c)
	}
}

func readConsumedViaHelper(root string, rec *changes.TaskRecord) {
	if c, err := containIn(root, rec.Files[0]); err == nil {
		openContained(c)
	}
}
